voice.caption: Achilles approaches with Patroclus, Antilochus, and Ajax nearby.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Achilles, no man was ever more blessed, nor will be: alive we honored you like a god, and here you rule with power among the dead. Do not grieve at dying — you of all men.

voice.speaker: achilles
voice.caption: Say not a word in death's favour, Odysseus. I would rather be a hired man, alive, working the fields of some poor farmer with little to live on, than rule over all the dead who have perished.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Would you hear of Peleus, and of your son Neoptolemus? Of your father I know nothing — but of the boy I can speak truly, for I myself brought him from Scyros to the war.
No. I will not reconciliation and withdraws in silence.

keys.beat: Achilles approaches with Patroclus, Antilochus, and Ajax nearby.
Odysseus tells Achilles no man was ever more blessed.
Achilles answers: rather a hired man alive than king over all the dead.
Ajax refuses reconciliation and withdraws in silence.
